# PickMyApp

> Honest guides, comparisons and reviews of business software. We check vendor pricing pages, test free plans where possible, take no paid placements, and note the date every price was checked.

## Guides

- [Run AI Models on Your Own PC: Llama for Windows and NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt Explained (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/run-ai-models-on-pc-llama-windows-nemotron-2026/): October 2026 is the week local AI went mainstream — Hugging Face's free Llama Windows app puts llama.cpp in your Windows 11 tray with one-click model downloads, and NVIDIA's 74B Nemotron 3.5 Bolt (Oct 15) fits a 74B-parameter agent model into 24 GB via 2-bit quantization. This guide explains both, what hardware you need, and when local AI beats the cloud.
- [ZoomInfo's Native n8n Integration Explained: Enrich Leads Automatically (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/zoominfo-n8n-integration-explained/): ZoomInfo launched a native, verified n8n node on October 12, 2026 (via GTM.AI) that connects workflows directly to its GTM Context Graph — 100M+ companies, 500M contacts, billions of signals. The article covers the 7 node operations, run-time enrichment workflows, AI Agent tool use, cost, and a native-node vs manual-HTTP comparison.
- [How to Use AI Agents for Lead Generation Without Coding (2026 Guide)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/ai-agents-for-lead-generation-no-coding/): Yes. A no-code AI agent can find prospects, enrich their data, and draft outreach for you. The practical setup: describe your ideal customer in plain language, connect your CRM and email, and let an agent run a five-stage pipeline — prospecting, enrichment, verification, outreach, follow-up — while you review its output.
- [Kit vs Beehiiv for Paid Newsletters: Which Pays Creators More? (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/kit-vs-beehiiv-paid-newsletters/): beehiiv pays creators more on paid subscriptions — 0% platform fee, you keep everything after Stripe. Kit's flat plans start cheaper at small lists but scale steeply, and it takes a commerce transaction fee on sales. Verdict by creator type included.
- [Best CRM for Consultants and Agencies in 2026: 7 Tools Compared](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-crm-consultants-agencies-2026/): Agencies sell trust, and trust starts with never dropping a follow-up. This guide compares seven CRMs against agency needs: client pipelines, retainer tracking, proposals and invoicing, and client portals. Prices were checked on vendor pricing pages in October 2026.
- [Best Free Project Management Tools for Startups in 2026: 8 Compared](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-free-project-management-tools-startups-2026/): For most startups, ClickUp has the strongest free plan in 2026: unlimited users, unlimited tasks, and core views at $0 with no expiry. Trello is the simplest free start, Notion is best when docs and tasks live together, Linear and Jira are the engineering-led picks, Asana and Todoist have the tightest free tiers, and Basecamp becomes unbeatable value at scale on its flat $299/month plan.
- [How to Renew SSL Certificates Automatically with Certbot (2026 Guide)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/renew-ssl-certificates-automatically-certbot/): Certbot's automatic renewal is a one-time, five-step job: install, obtain with an automated plugin, test with --dry-run, verify the timer, and add a reload hook — essential before Let's Encrypt switches to 64-day certificates on Feb 10, 2027.
- [Best AI Writing Tools for Marketing Agencies in 2026: 8 Compared](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-ai-writing-tools-marketing-agencies-2026/): For most marketing agencies in 2026, Jasper is the strongest all-round pick: trained brand voices, campaign agents, and a Canvas workspace built for producing on-brand copy across many clients. Copy.ai wins on repeatable workflows, Writesonic is the value pick, Scalenut leads for SEO content, Anyword for conversion prediction, Writer for enterprise governance — while Rytr is the cheapest way in.
- [Best Website Builder for Photographers in 2026: 7 Compared](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-website-builder-photographers-2026/): For most photographers, Squarespace is the best website builder in 2026: photography-first templates, unlimited storage, and built-in print selling from $16 per month billed annually. Format ($10/mo) is the best photographer-specific pick, and Adobe Portfolio the best option if you already pay for Lightroom.
- [Cheapest Live Chat Software for Websites in 2026: 8 Budget Picks](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/cheapest-live-chat-software-websites-2026/): The cheapest live chat software for websites in 2026, compared with real pricing: free plans, per-agent costs, chatbot fees and hidden add-ons across 8 tools.
- [Let's Encrypt Is Cutting SSL Certificate Lifetimes to 64 Days: What Website Owners Must Do Before February 2027 (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/lets-encrypt-ssl-certificate-64-days-2027/): Let's Encrypt drops default certificate lifetimes from 90 to 64 days on February 10, 2027. This guide covers the verified timeline and a 5-step automation checklist so your site never serves an expired certificate.
- [MyID Authenticate Explained: Passkey Windows Logon for Phishing-Resistant Small Teams (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/myid-authenticate-passkey-windows-logon/): Intercede's MyID Authenticate brings phishing-resistant passkey sign-in to Windows desktops, VPNs, and legacy apps. Here's what it is, how it works, and how it compares to alternatives for small teams.
- [Best AI Agent Builders for Non-Developers in 2026: 6 Tools Compared](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/best-ai-agent-builders-non-developers-2026/): Lindy is the easiest entry ($29.99/user/mo) inside Slack; Gumloop is the best value ($37/mo, unlimited seats); Zapier Agents wins on its 9,000-app ecosystem; Relay.app suits approval-heavy workflows; Relevance AI is cheapest for multi-agent builds; Botpress is most capable but least beginner-friendly. All six compared with real Oct 2026 pricing and the limits a non-developer will hit.
- [MailerLite vs ConvertKit for Newsletters in 2026: Which Should You Pick?](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/mailerlite-vs-convertkit-newsletters/): MailerLite is 40–50% cheaper at every list size ($19 vs $39 at 1k subs, $89 vs $139 at 10k) and includes paid newsletters and RSS-to-email on its $12/mo Comfort plan. Kit wins for creators monetizing through paid recommendations, its sponsor network, and Kit Commerce (3.5% + $0.30). Verdict by newsletter type included.
- [Zoho CRM vs HubSpot for Small Business: Which Is Worth It? (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/zoho-crm-vs-hubspot-small-business/): For most businesses with 1 to 20 people, Zoho CRM wins on total cost of ownership and HubSpot wins on ease of use. Both have real free plans: HubSpot covers up to 2 users, Zoho covers up to 3. Once you pay, Zoho's Standard plan ($14/user/month billed annually) undercuts HubSpot's Starter ($15/seat/month), and Zoho's priciest CRM tier ($52/user/month) costs less than one HubSpot Professional seat ($90/month) — before HubSpot's mandatory $1,500 onboarding fee. Pick HubSpot only if your team needs zero learning curve and native marketing tools, and your budget survives the upgrade cliff.
- [Linear vs Jira for Software Teams: Which Should You Pick? (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/linear-vs-jira-software-teams/): If your team is under about 15 developers and wants to ship fast, choose Linear: you can be running in an afternoon, paid plans start at $10 per seat per month billed annually, and it includes an AI agent even on the free tier. Choose Jira if you need custom workflows, granular permissions, compliance certifications, or non-engineering teams on the same tracker. Free tiers: Jira covers up to 10 users; Linear covers unlimited members but only 250 issues.
- [Copy.ai vs Writesonic for Marketing Teams: Which Wins in 2026?](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/copy-ai-vs-writesonic-marketing-teams/): Copy.ai automates go-to-market workflows for revenue teams; Writesonic produces SEO and AI-search content for publishers. A marketing-team-lens comparison of real October 2026 pricing, team features, and integrations.
- [Framer vs Webflow Compared: Which Is Better in 2026?](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/framer-vs-webflow-compared/): Framer is the fast, affordable pick for portfolios and marketing sites; Webflow is the production platform for CMS-heavy sites, blogs at scale, and ecommerce. Real October 2026 pricing and a verdict by what you're building.
- [Tidio vs Intercom Compared: The Honest Pick for Small Stores in 2026](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/tidio-vs-intercom-compared/): Tidio is the better pick for most small ecommerce stores. It starts free, its Growth plan costs from about $49 a month billed annually with up to 10 agents on one flat workspace fee, and its Lyro AI agent costs roughly $0.70 per AI conversation. Intercom wins when you scale: per-seat pricing from $29 a month, deeper workflows, and the Fin AI agent at $0.99 per resolution. A five-person team on 2,000 chats a month can pay over $1,100 a month on Intercom once Fin fees land — versus a few hundred on Tidio.
- [How to Fix Excel Running Slow on Windows 11 (2026): 9 Fixes That Work](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/fix-excel-running-slow-windows-11-2026/): The three fixes that resolve most slow-Excel cases on Windows 11: (1) disable faulty add-ins by testing in Safe Mode (Win + R, then excel /safe), (2) turn off hardware graphics acceleration under File > Options > Advanced > Display, and (3) switch calculation to manual on formula-heavy workbooks (Formulas > Calculation Options > Manual). If only one file is slow, the workbook itself is bloated — clear conditional formatting, reset the used range, and save as .xlsb.
- [Cloudflare Acquires Deno Explained: What It Means for Workers Developers and Self-Hosting (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/cloudflare-acquires-deno-explained/): On October 9, 2026, Cloudflare announced it is acquiring Deno and bringing Ryan Dahl's entire team in-house to merge Deno's open-source celld into Cloudflare's workerd runtime — making Workers self-hosting a first-class option. Deno runtime gets one year of maintenance, Deno Deploy shuts down in six months; Workers users change nothing, Deno users should plan migrations.
- [Anthropic Cyber Mission Explained: The Free Vulnerability Scanner for Open-Source Projects (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/anthropic-cyber-mission-explained/): On October 8, 2026, Anthropic announced something unusual for an AI lab: not a model, but a defensive cybersecurity program. The Anthropic Cyber Mission aims its AI at defenders — open-source maintainers and critical-infrastructure operators — to find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers do.
- [Activepieces vs n8n: Open-Source Automation Compared (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/activepieces-vs-n8n-open-source-automation/): Activepieces and n8n both charge per workflow run rather than per step and both can self-host, but they split on license (MIT vs fair-code), ease of use, and catalog depth — this guide compares pricing, pieces vs nodes, AI features, and self-hosting effort with real October-2026 numbers to tell you which fits your team.
- [ConvertKit Alternatives for Bloggers: 7 Email Tools Compared (2026)](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/convertkit-alternatives-for-bloggers/): A "which alternative fits YOUR kind of blog" comparison (not a head-on ConvertKit-vs-X piece): newsletter bloggers → Beehiiv/Substack/Ghost; affiliate bloggers → MailerLite/Brevo/Mailchimp; digital-product sellers → Ghost/Flodesk — with real October-2026 pricing, free plans, automations, migration and deliverability basics.

- [ClickUp Pricing Explained: Is It Worth It in 2026?](https://pickmyapp.github.io/blog/clickup-pricing-explained-2026/): ClickUp costs $8 per user/month on Core and $17 on Business (billed annually), but the plan you actually need depends on limits most articles skip — 60 MB of storage on Free, lifetime feature "uses" that never reset, and limited guest seats on paid plans. For most small teams it is worth it: one subscription replaces two or three, but only if the whole team actually lives in it.
